_comment: 리워드 아이템 그림 작업 목록 (docs/design/item-art/brief.md 2·3·4번). 이미지 모델에 prompt를 한 줄씩 넘긴다(gen_item_art.py). 밥(goma, yakionigiri)과 흰 밥(plain_rice)은 tools/make_onigiri_svg.py가 그리므로 여기에 없다. 기본 요리사 모자(chef_hat)는 make_onigiri_svg.py의 hat()이 그리고(drawnBy), 여기에는 넣는 도구의 검사용 놓는 값만 둔다. 넣는 단계(place_item_art.py)의 값: 머리(top)는 head-fit.md의 맞춤 방식 fit(swallow 삼키기 / band 가로지르기 / carve 깎아 얹기 / drape 걸치기 / overlay 앞에 겹치기)으로 놓는다. kind(hat 모자류 / topping 토핑)와 box [폭, 높이]는 크기 상한용이고 그림을 이 상자 안으로 줄인다. anchor는 잘라 낸 그림 안의 닿는 점 비율 [x, y](없으면 carve·drape·band는 아래 가장자리 가운데, overlay는 한가운데). carve·drape는 닿는 점 P(dx) = (150 + dx, 182 − √(72² − dx²))에 anchor를 맞추고 rotate(도, SVG rotate 부호. 음수면 오른쪽이 올라감)만큼 돌린 뒤 press("auto"면 contactSpan(기본 0.8) 구간의 아랫변이 몸 외곽선 안쪽 가장자리 + carveInset까지 들어가게 누름)하고 본체 마스크를 6 + carveInset 깎은 영역으로 깎는다. band는 anchor를 bandTarget(360 좌표)에 맞추고 몸 외곽선 안쪽 가장자리로 자른다(clipExempt 다각형은 자르지 않음). overlay는 anchor를 center에 맞춘다(visibleTilt: 그림 자체 기울기를 더한 보이는 기울기). erase는 그림 손질로 지울 다각형(잘라 낸 그림 안의 비율 좌표), squash는 비율을 지키지 않고 box에 맞추는 임시 손질이다. 모든 머리 아이템은 넣는 단계에서 바깥 외곽선을 굵기 6으로 다시 그린다. 속재료(filling)는 layer(back/front), direction(왼쪽 수평에서 위로 도), depth(E (54, 189)에서 몸 안쪽 거리), length(긴 축 길이), anchor(안쪽 끝, 없으면 오른쪽 가장자리 가운데)로 놓는다(brief.md 2.3.5·2.3.6). 배경(background)은 targetBox 360×360과 kanaBoxes(그림에 합성할 가나와 자리)다. 기리 좌표는 모두 360 좌표계(viewBox -30 0 360 360).

items.prompt: A simple front view of a small Japanese eatery entrance: a dark indigo split noren curtain hanging across the top-left of a wooden doorway, light cream plaster wall, a little potted plant at the bottom-right edge. The center of the picture is a calm, very light, almost empty wall area. Leave the noren cloth plain with no letters.

One slice of Japanese tamagoyaki (sweet rolled omelette) drawn completely flat in 2D, seen from the side: a long soft yellow strip of even thickness, about three times as wide as it is tall, bent into a shallow arch like a wide frown, the middle higher than both ends, so its bottom edge is clearly curved upward (concave), as if draped on top of a ball (do not draw the ball). One narrow dark seaweed band wrapped around its middle from top to bottom. Flat solid colors with no gradient, no 3D end face, no spiral, no shadow. Only the omelette strip and the seaweed band.

One cut slice of tonkatsu (breaded fried pork cutlet) drawn completely flat in 2D, shaped like a wide rainbow arch: a long curved strip about three times as wide as it is tall, bent like an upside-down U that is very shallow, both ends lower than the middle, the top edge and the bottom edge are parallel curves, so the bottom edge arches upward in the middle with empty space under it. A thick golden brown crispy crust border all around with a bumpy, softly wavy outline, and a pale cream pork meat center. Plain meat with no dots, no marks, no face. Flat fills, no 3D side, no white sticker border, nothing under it.

One chikuwa (Japanese tube-shaped fish cake) drawn completely flat in 2D, lying horizontally and seen from the side: a long tube about three times as wide as it is tall, bent into a shallow arch like a wide frown, the middle higher than both ends, so its bottom edge is clearly curved upward (concave), as if resting on top of a ball (do not draw the ball). Only the left end is turned slightly toward the viewer, showing a large round dark hole. Off-white ends and one wide toasted warm brown band covering the middle, flat solid colors with no gradient. Only the one tube, no sauce, no seaweed powder.

One shrimp tempura (ebi tempura) lying horizontally, shown alone as a flat object: a long body in warm yellow batter with a softly wavy outline, the right end cut straight across, and at the left end a small fan-shaped orange red shrimp tail sticking out. Only the one tempura, no sauce, no crumbs, no plate.

A simple, completely empty Japanese train station platform with nobody on it: pale sky, a blank station name board on two short posts at the top-left, a yellow tactile line along the platform edge at the bottom, a bit of a train window at the right edge. The middle of the picture is just empty pale platform and sky. Leave the station name board blank with no letters.

One chunk of grilled salted salmon (shake) lying horizontally, shown alone as a flat object: a rounded wedge in soft salmon orange with two thin curved off-white fat lines across it, the right end cut straight across. No skin, no grill marks. Only the one salmon piece.

A simple shrine approach: a vermilion torii gate framing the picture with its top beam across the top and its two pillars at the left and right edges, a light stone path in the middle, soft green-grey shrubs at the bottom corners, pale sky. The center is a calm, very light, almost empty area.

A small white Japanese fox festival mask (kitsune omen) shown alone as a flat object, front view, upright: a rounded face shape with two pointed ears on top, two narrow curved eye slits drawn with thick bold lines, a few simple broad orange-red markings on the cheeks and forehead. Very few inner lines, all as thick as the outline. Flat sticker drawing of the mask itself, no cord, no string, no head inside it, nothing behind it.
items.palette: Use only two fill colors: warm off-white and soft orange red. No blue, no grey, no other colors.

items.prompt: An open straight strip with two separate ends, not a circle, not a ring, not a loop, not bent back like a hook, no hole in the middle, no perspective. One straight piece of thick twisted cloth rope lying horizontally, drawn flat in 2D: dark indigo blue and white strands twisted together like a candy cane stripe, about five times as wide as it is tall, very slightly curved like a wide smile, the middle a little lower than the ends. The left end is cut off straight. At the right end there is one big round knot, clearly thicker than the rope. Two short wide flat tails come out of the top of the knot and spread apart toward the right: one tail slants up and to the right, the other points out to the right almost sideways, and both tips droop slightly. The tails do not stand straight up.
items.palette: Use only two colors: dark indigo blue and warm off-white rice white. No other colors at all.

items.prompt: A simple bathhouse entrance: an indigo noren curtain hanging at the top-left, warm wooden frame, a light wooden floor and a pair of small sandals at the bottom-right edge, faint soft steam curls. The center is a calm, very light, almost empty area. Leave the noren cloth plain with no letters.

A small folded cotton hand towel drawn completely flat in 2D, seen straight from the front: one plump rounded rectangle about two and a half times as wide as it is tall, with softly rounded corners, a straight flat bottom edge and a straight flat top edge. Like a white towel whose two short ends were dipped in dark indigo dye. It is made of three upright sections side by side: a wide dark indigo blue section at the left end, a plain white section in the middle, and a wide dark indigo blue section at the right end. Each indigo section is about a quarter of the width and runs the full height from the top edge to the bottom edge. Thick even dark outline. No perspective, no top surface, no shadow, no puffy dome, no loose cloth, nothing hanging down. Only the towel.
items.palette: Use only two fill colors: warm off-white and dark indigo blue. No stripes of any other color, no other colors at all.

items.prompt: One small Japanese steamed bun (onsen manju) drawn completely flat in 2D, front view: one plain soft bun in a single flat warm wood brown color, shaped like a soft cushion slumped over the top of a ball (do not draw the ball): a rounded top, about one and a half times as wide as it is tall, and the bottom edge clearly curved upward in the middle (concave), with both lower corners drooping a little lower than the middle. Smooth surface with nothing on top: no cream, no icing, no white cap, no stamp, no mark, no highlight, no gradient. Only the one bun.

One Japanese pickled plum (umeboshi) drawn completely flat in 2D, front view: a slightly squashed wrinkly round shape, a little wider than tall, in one flat soft orange red color, with two or three short curved wrinkle lines on its surface drawn in the outline color. It is a soft shrivelled pickled plum, not a fresh fruit: no stem, no leaf, no seed, no shine, no highlight, no bowl. Only the one plum.
items.palette: Use only soft orange red for the fill. No other colors, no color swatches.
